title: Stationing Receipt
description: One ratified act, as one content-addressed file (the L6 pattern). The file's own name is the SHA-256 of its canonical payload, so every receipt is independently verifiable and two clones adding receipts can never merge-conflict. There is deliberately NO cross-record chain: ordering is by the ts field, and nothing exists for a union merge to break. Receipts live in the REGION's own tree under grimoires/loa/territory/receipts/.

kind.description: What act this receipt records. Install receipts reuse this writer (sprint-229).

ts.description: UTC, second precision. Ordering across receipts is by this field, never by chain position. SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH honored.

actor.description: OS user who ran the recording. Locally spoofable, rate-visible in audit — stated honestly (SDD §5).

outcomes.description: The outcome ids this stationing answers for, sorted. Copied from the ratified loadout row.

authority_tier.description: The CEILING declared in the manifest at recording time — never the earned tier. Earned lives in the L4 ledger.

manifest_hash.description: Hash of the region's territory.yaml bytes at validation — one of the four snapshotted authorization inputs.

key_id.description: Present only when a network-registry key participated. Stationing itself is keyless.

verification.description: The remaining snapshotted authorization inputs, re-verified immediately before the write (TOCTOU guard).

l4_ledger_tip.description: Hash of the region's trust ledger at validation, or 'absent' when no ledger exists yet.

anchor.description: 'origin/<branch>' when HEAD was contained in the remote default branch at recording; 'local-only' when the region has no remote. A local-only receipt never claims remote ratification.
